## Refinement codes

String codes that refine a base exit with a finer message — same exit, same wire code family, a more specific `code`. Cited by the `Fail` call sites.

| Constant | Code |
|---|---|
| `CodeBrokenCitation` | `broken_citation` |
| `CodeDocsDrift` | `docs_drift` |
